text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

Thanks for reaching out. I can help you three find a plan, though I won't make the decision for you. To start, could you tell me why you need the trailer in the next few weeks, and what matters most to you about how it's shared? Once I hear from A and B as well, I'll keep a shared list of everyone's concerns so we can compare options against it.
I need it for hauling on a home project, and it needs to happen in the next few weeks. What matters most is being able to use it when I need it—not just waiting until A is done.

Hi A, C has asked me to help the three of you sort out scheduling and use of the shared trailer. Could you tell me what you need the trailer for in the next few weeks, and what matters most to you in how it's shared? I'll keep a shared list of everyone's concerns as we go, so please tell me if I get anything wrong.
I want to use it for weekend trips in the next few weeks. What matters most is having the freedom to make plans and use it when I need it.

Hi B, C has asked me to help the three of you sort out scheduling and use of the shared trailer. Since it lives at your place, your situation matters a lot here. Could you tell me what you need the trailer for in the next few weeks, and what matters most to you in how it's shared or stored? I'll keep a shared list of everyone's concerns as we go, so please tell me if I get anything wrong.

I don’t have a particular use for it in the next few weeks. I’d prefer it not take up space on my pad, though I know I agreed to keep it here. I’d need my landlord’s approval for any change to what’s stored there, and I haven’t asked him yet.

Thanks A and C for your replies, and B too. Here is the shared list of concerns as I have it so far. Please tell me if anything is wrong or missing.

1. A: needs the trailer for weekend trips in the next few weeks, and wants freedom to use it when needed.
2. C: needs it for hauling on a home project in the next few weeks, and wants access when needed rather than waiting until A is done.
3. B: has no personal use in the next few weeks, prefers the trailer not take space on her pad, and needs her landlord's approval for any change to what is stored there. That last point is worth checking with the landlord soon.

A possible starting option: block specific dates in a shared calendar, splitting the next few weeks between A's weekends and C's project days, so neither has to wait indefinitely. B's main ask is about space, not dates. What do you all think?
My concern is right. I’m open to a shared calendar, but I don’t want a fixed split that blocks my weekend plans; let’s keep it flexible and settle dates soon.

That’s accurate for me. A calendar could work, but we need to agree on dates soon so I’m not left waiting while A uses it.

B, C likes the calendar idea and wants dates agreed soon. Do you have any dates or space limits to add, or would you rather just know when each pickup will happen so you can plan around the trailer being gone?
I don’t have dates to suggest; knowing when each pickup is would help me plan. I’d still prefer the trailer not stay on my pad, but I’d need to check with my landlord before changing the arrangement.

A and C both like the calendar idea but differ on flexibility. Here is a compromise to check against the concerns list: C's hauling days get booked first as fixed dates, since C's project is on a deadline, and A keeps the remaining weekends free to use flexibly once those days are set. That gives C the certainty of not waiting, and A flexibility on the rest. B only needs to know the pickup dates. Would each of you accept that if C proposes specific project dates?
I can accept that if C proposes the fixed dates soon and my remaining weekends stay available for flexible use.

B, the plan for you is simply that you will be told the pickup dates in advance, and your landlord question stays open since you said you'd check before changing the storage arrangement. Please confirm with C directly which dates work, and let me know if anything changes.
Sure, once C proposes the dates, I’ll let them know which work for me. I’ll also get back to you if anything changes.
